# Misfit Mediahouse — Machine Products + Agent Infrastructure

Misfit Mediahouse builds hosted tools, machine-commerce surfaces, agent security, and infrastructure that can be consumed directly by AI systems.

## Durable agent control plane
Human-readable control plane: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents
A2A Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Canonical agent-facing business map: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agents.md
Static public-safe stack manifest: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-stack.json
Live public-safe health API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-agent-hub/health
Public-safe recovery guide: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/Misfit-media-designer-lite/blob/main/docs/AGENT_CONTROL_PLANE_RECOVERY.md
Canonical runtime state lives in Misfit Cloud/Supabase; source and recovery metadata live in GitHub; the website is the durable public control surface. Chat sessions are operators, not databases.

Private cognitive-kernel runtime details are intentionally not exposed through public surfaces. The private upstream cognitive/governance kernel is internal infrastructure, not a public product, checkout offer, MCP product, or public source package.

## A2A — Misfit Machine Agent
A2A v1.0 JSONRPC endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a/rpc
A2A v1.0 HTTP+JSON endpoint: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-a2a
Agent Card: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
Third-party A2A registry identity: a2aregistry.org/agents/9bfce891-edc3-4ba9-ba84-53f8873007c6
Current public-safe skills include public business scrubs, public Shopify agentic-storefront audits, public A2A Agent Card trust audits, and bounded advisory action-governance checks. Private kernel implementation is not part of the public contract. The agent does not advertise streaming, push notifications, cart/order/payment execution, credential access, deployment mutation, or target-agent execution.

## Machine commerce discovery
UCP business profile: https://misfitmediahouse.com/.well-known/ucp
UCP REST catalog: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-ucp
UCP MCP storefront: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/misfit-machine-store-mcp
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/misfit-machine-store
Catalog search and lookup are advertised. Purchase handoff uses each public product's existing checkout flow; UCP checkout is not advertised.

## Misfit Business Scrub
Public-signal revenue-readiness diagnostic for a business website: web foundation, conversion path, discoverability, trust/email DNS, automation and AI-readiness signals. It returns prioritized leaks and a recommended Misfit offer without taking the proposed action.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/scrub
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/business-scrub
GET query: `website`
POST JSON: `{ "website": "https://example.com" }`
A2A: call `scrub_public_business` through Misfit Machine Agent.

## A2A Agent Trust Audit
Public-metadata-only trust/readiness diagnostic for A2A Agent Cards and their declared machine interfaces. It never executes a target-agent skill.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/a2a-agent-audit
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/a2a-agent-trust-audit
A2A: call `audit_a2a_agent_card` on Misfit Machine Agent.

## Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab
Pilot evaluation package for authorized raw-agent vs governed-agent comparisons. The evaluation measures dangerous-action block rate, decision-change rate, benign false-refusal rate, retained goal completion, human escalation, and audit completeness across the same objective/scenario. The commercial deliverable is comparative evidence and integration findings, not access to the private cognitive kernel.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab
Machine-readable package: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab.json
Illustrative public-safe sample report: https://misfitmediahouse.com/agent-evaluation-lab-sample-report.json
Intake: https://misfitmediahouse.com/operator?challenge=agent-governance-evaluation&track=client
Status: pilot. The sample report is synthetic and is not customer evidence, certification, regulatory attestation, or proof of universal safety. Protected kernel internals, private prompts, hidden policy internals, private packets, credentials, and reconstruction material are excluded from the public contract.

## Shopify Agentic Audit
Public-metadata-only UCP/MCP storefront readiness and tool-surface audit for Shopify stores. It never executes cart, checkout, order, payment, credential, or mutation actions.
Page: https://misfitmediahouse.com/shopify-ai-audit
API: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/shopify-agentic-audit
A2A: call `audit_shopify_agentic_storefront` through Misfit Machine Agent.
Consequential findings may be evaluated through Misfit's private governance boundary without exposing the private cognitive kernel.

## ChangePacket
Persistent change memory for AI agents. Track public webpages or public MCP tool surfaces. First request creates a baseline; later requests return only the delta.
Product: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed
MCP: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/changepacket-mcp
OpenAPI: https://cibcxqrqiqvzpardbdrw.supabase.co/functions/v1/deltafeed/openapi.json
MCP Registry identity: io.github.MisfitMEdiAhouse/changepacket
Pricing: 25 free calls/day; 2,000 prepaid calls for $9.

## ContextForge
Metadata-aware code generation and change governance grounded in DataHub context.
App: https://contextforge-datahub-app.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/MisfitMEdiAhouse/contextforge-datahub
Do not assume a standalone remote ContextForge MCP or A2A server unless one is explicitly published.

## Private cognitive and security core
The private cognitive/governance kernel and related private governance/security components operate only as Misfit-controlled internal infrastructure. Public contracts may expose sanitized decisions or advisory results through Misfit-branded interfaces, but private source, prompts, mappings, policy internals, credentials, protected packets, and reconstruction material are not public interfaces or commercial products.

## Public portfolio
Canonical deduplicated portfolio: https://misfitmediahouse.com/portfolio
IALS Turbine Command proof case: https://misfitmediahouse.com/portfolio/ials-turbine-command
IALS is a two-surface aerospace aftermarket operating system built by Misfit Mediahouse. The public surface supports part-number discovery, bearing recovery and demand acquisition; the private operator workflow matches repair pricing to inventory, compares repair routes, gates spend before overhaul, manages compliance evidence and generates customer-facing transaction documents. Current published aggregate proof: 94 repair-price P/N rows, 22 inventory-to-pricing matches, 4 multi-shop comparison P/Ns and 12 priced matches with known quantity. Private vendor names, exact rates, customer records, signed documents and controlled technical data are not public.
Misfit AI V2: https://misfit-ai-v2.vercel.app/
Coffee & A Joint: https://www.coffeeandajoint.co/
Iron Network — equipment rental: https://misfit-equipment-network.vercel.app/
Home Efficiency Pros: https://www.homeefficiencypros.com/
NexGrid Energy: https://nexgridenergy.net/

Canonical company site: https://misfitmediahouse.com/

## Work with Misfit
Proof-first human handoff for companies, clients, partners, dealer programs, and hiring teams: https://misfitmediahouse.com/operator
Personalized links may include the public query parameters `company`, `site`, `challenge`, and `track` (`embedded`, `fractional`, `partner`, or `client`). The page can route a public website into the Business Scrub and capture a human-approved challenge. It does not authorize an agent to apply, accept terms, connect accounts, deploy, purchase, or act on a company's behalf.
